summary: Iteration 7 full test pass. Backend pytest 10/10 (test_iteration7.py). Frontend Playwright verified: reklamation-panel on admin Dashboard, activity-table on /aktivitaet (admin-only, mitarbeiter/techniker redirected), LanguageSwitcher DE/EN/AR toggles document.dir=rtl for AR + lang=ar/en/de, ContractPrint modal opens from OrderDetail [data-testid=open-contract] AND from Orders table [data-testid=quick-print-*] without navigating (stopPropagation confirmed). Modal exposes contract-customer, contract-device, contract-terms, contract-print-button, contract-close-button (no OS print triggered). Technician (chris) sees NO quick-print buttons and NO Aktivität nav link. Full FERTIG e2e verified with fresh order RB-2026-00059 assigned to chris: mark-ready DISABLED with no media+no insp, DISABLED after insp only, still DISABLED with media+no insp, ENABLES only when BOTH insp saved AND repair media present — clicking then transitions to FERTIG (toast 'Status: Fertig'). Inspection form data-testids all present (insp-item-battery/wifi/fingerprint/faceid/housing/cameras plus OK/NOK/NV buttons, insp-note-*, insp-display-type, insp-battery-health, insp-notes, insp-save). Toast 'Prüfprotokoll gespeichert' shown. Status label 'Diagnose' (replacing 'Angenommen') present 31x on Orders page including StatusBadge, filter-tab-angenommen label, dashboard Status-Verteilung, and manual status dropdown. Terminology on /auftrag/neu confirmed: labels 'Arbeitskosten (€)' and 'Materialkosten (€)' present; NO 'Arbeitslohn' or 'Ersatzteilkosten' anywhere on OrderCreate/OrderDetail/Invoice. Backend audit PRUEFPROTOKOLL entry created on inspection save.

issues: Third column label reads 'Material' (short) while the summary row below and OrderCreate use full 'Materialkosten'. Minor inconsistency; consider renaming column label to 'Materialkosten' for consistency with the rest of the app.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Rename OrderDetail.jsx L429 label 'Material' to 'Materialkosten' for consistency.

(Code quality) GET /api/reklamationen returns items where legacy orders may omit 'is_reclamation' key entirely; consider always echoing is_reclamation (default false) in serialize_order for a stable schema — not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is now ~1381 lines — still growing. Recommend splitting into inspection.py, activity.py, reklamation.py modules alongside existing endpoints.
FERTIG gate correctly checks BOTH repair-media AND inspection presence; disable-state on frontend mark-ready mirrors both conditions with helpful title hints. Solid UX.
InspectionForm cleanly reuses order.inspection to prefill on re-open (readOnly capability provided but not currently wired from OrderDetail — future improvement to lock the checklist after FERTIG).
ContractPrint modal correctly uses window.addEventListener('afterprint') to auto-close (no OS print dialog triggered during automated testing since we never clicked contract-print-button).
Global /api/activity fetches all audit entries plus order lookup map; for large audit_log this will get heavy — consider paginating and joining via aggregation.
Quick-print row click uses e.stopPropagation() correctly — no accidental navigation observed.
